title: Final dispatch-time admission gate
intent: Block worker-backed deployments at dispatch time when the selected worker's latest repository state no longer satisfies universal worker admission.
observed_behavior_before: Coordinator selected a worker, then submitted the Loom job without reloading current worker telemetry or pressure state.
intended_behavior: After worker selection and before Loom SubmitJob, coordinator reloads the selected worker through worker policy admission, evaluates service_deploy admission, and fails the deployment run without submitting when admission rejects. Workerless paths remain ungated.
